title: Binary Tree Coloring Game
summary: In a binary tree game, two players take turns coloring nodes.
statement: In a binary tree game, two players take turns coloring nodes. The first player selects a node to color red, and the second player selects a different node to color blue. Players then alternate turns, coloring an uncolored neighbor of their colored node. If a player cannot make a move, they pass. The game ends when both pass, and the player who colored more nodes wins. As the second player, determine if you can choose a node to ensure a win.
constraints: Tree values are unique and x is the first player’s node.
The second player chooses one node before expansion begins.
